gaps.sentence: ___ single room in the hotel was fully booked.
gaps.explanation: 'Every single room' is the emphatic collocation meaning 'without exception'.

gaps.sentence: ___ candidate was given five minutes to speak.
gaps.hint: one at a time, singular verb
gaps.explanation: 'Each candidate was given' — singular agreement; 'all candidate' is wrong.

gaps.sentence: The new model has ___ moving parts, so it breaks down less often.
gaps.explanation: 'Fewer moving parts' is correct because 'parts' is countable and plural.

gaps.sentence: ___ John and his brother are doctors.
gaps.explanation: 'Both John and his brother are ...' links two people affirmatively; 'neither' and 'either' pair with 'nor/or'.
'Somewhere' is used in affirmative sentences; adjectives like 'quiet' follow the -where word.

gaps.sentence: We had ___ luggage that the taxi couldn't take it all.
gaps.explanation: 'So much luggage that …' — luggage is uncountable.
'Too cold to swim' means the temperature prevents swimming; 'enough' would follow the adjective.

gaps.sentence: Don't rush — we've got ___ of time.
gaps.hint: fixed pattern: ___ of time (no article needed)
gaps.explanation: 'Plenty of time' needs no article; 'lot of time' would need 'a', and 'much of time' needs 'the'.
